name: Mortis (Cadaverous Animation) — 3 Advanced — Master the Corpse Army

system.description: You can create an army of Athanatoi. Spend 10 minutes anointing as many warriors as you wish with three Blood Traits. Animating and controlling the array use the same challenges as a single Athanatos, but you are one Trait down for each body you are animating beyond the initial one (e.g. animating five corpses leaves you four Traits down for the initial challenge and for all control challenges). You cannot augment the abilities of these Athanatoi, but they gain the usual benefits from being created of warrior stock. Your control extends over the entire group — losing control of one loses control of the whole group. This power may also create multiple servants as per Raise the Corpse to Service using the same procedure, though you need not exert your will to control them; such servants last until daybreak.
